claims.text: GitHub Container Registry is at ghcr.io and stores images as ghcr.io/NAMESPACE/IMAGE_NAME, where NAMESPACE is the personal account or organization that owns them.
claims.source_hint: GitHub Docs: Working with the Container registry

claims.text: From stage-2, ci.yml's publish job pushes ghcr.io/duyan11110/donhang-api and ghcr.io/duyan11110/donhang-migrate (ci.yml@stage-2 lines 161-166); duyan11110 owns the repository duyan11110/don-hang.
claims.source_hint: examples/don-hang @ stage-2 .github/workflows/ci.yml:159-166; gh repo view duyan11110/don-hang

claims.text: GitHub creates a unique GITHUB_TOKEN at the start of each workflow job; it expires when the job finishes (or when the job reaches its maximum run time). Workflows read it as secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN; jobs can have different permissions.
claims.source_hint: GitHub Docs: Automatic token authentication (About the GITHUB_TOKEN secret)

claims.text: A workflow can log in to ghcr.io with GITHUB_TOKEN; to push packages the token needs packages: write, granted with the permissions key.
claims.source_hint: GitHub Docs: Working with the Container registry (Authenticating in a GitHub Actions workflow); Publishing Docker images

claims.text: If permissions: is set for a job, every permission not listed is set to none (metadata stays read); run 36332055445 publish log lists GITHUB_TOKEN Permissions: Metadata: read, Packages: write.
claims.source_hint: GitHub Docs: Workflow syntax > permissions; gh run view --job 108656157711 --log -R duyan11110/don-hang

claims.text: docker login --password-stdin reads the password from standard input, so it does not appear on the command line (shell history, process list).
publish runs only when github.event_name == 'push' and github.ref == 'refs/heads/master', needs [test, image]; on pull_request events test and image run but publish is skipped.
publish downloads the images artifact, docker loads images.tar, docker tags donhang-api:stage-2 and donhang-migrate:stage-2 with ghcr.io names and pushes them; there is no docker build in the job.
docker tag creates an additional name (reference) for an existing image; it does not build or copy image data, and both names show the same image ID.
The ghcr.io/duyan11110/donhang-api package is public: docker manifest inspect and docker pull work without docker login.
claims.source_hint: executed without ghcr credentials: docker manifest inspect / docker pull ghcr.io/duyan11110/donhang-api:sha-7a131bc8...

claims.text: A personal access token acts as its owner within its scopes (classic) or granted permissions (fine-grained) and stays valid until it expires or is revoked; GITHUB_TOKEN is limited to the repository and the job.
claims.source_hint: GitHub Docs: Managing your personal access tokens; Automatic token authentication

claims.text: Push only green commits from the main branch when the registry should hold only images the team would run; anyone who can pull an image can run it.
claims.source_hint: follows from ci.yml@stage-2 publish condition; GitHub Docs: Container registry visibility

claims.text: If GITHUB_TOKEN lacks packages: write, docker push to ghcr.io is refused (access denied) and the step fails.
claims.source_hint: GitHub Docs: Working with the Container registry (permissions for GITHUB_TOKEN); community reports of 'denied: permission_denied: write_package'

claims.text: staging and publish both need [test, image] and both load images.tar; publish does not need staging (run 36332055445: publish finished 16:10:13Z, staging 16:10:25Z).

duyan11110/don-hang's default workflow permissions are read (gh api .../actions/permissions/workflow -> default_workflow_permissions: read); the image job's log shows Contents: read, Metadata: read, Packages: read.

Run 36332055445 publish log: 'Loaded image: donhang-api:stage-2', login, then push printing 'sha-7a131bc8...: digest: sha256:1d0825b5...'; no build step. docker buildx imagetools inspect of that tag today shows Digest sha256:1d0825b5...
claims.source_hint: gh run view --job 108656157711 --log -R duyan11110/don-hang; docker buildx imagetools inspect (executed 2026-10-03)

claims.text: GITHUB_ACTOR is the name of the person or app that initiated the workflow; GITHUB_SHA is the commit SHA that triggered the workflow (default environment variables).
claims.source_hint: GitHub Docs: Variables reference > Default environment variables

claims.text: GitHub Packages calls each stored container image name (e.g. donhang-api) a package; packages: write is the GITHUB_TOKEN permission for publishing to GitHub Packages, including ghcr.io.
claims.source_hint: GitHub Docs: Introduction to GitHub Packages; Working with the Container registry

claims.text: People with read access to a repository can download a workflow run's artifacts from the run's summary page (while retained).
